provenance: Real output of git ls-tree as src/gates/merge-preconditions.ts entryLookupFault runs it at the merge base (git --literal-pathspecs ls-tree -z <rev> -- <entry without its trailing slash>), captured 2026-09-30 by the M6-P5 implementer with git 2.43.0 against the scratch repository test/merge-preconditions.test.ts stages in stageDirectoryEntryRepo: a base holding charter.yaml and src/feature.ts. The three listings the lookup tells apart are a blob (src/feature.ts, a prefix entry naming a FILE), a tree (src, a directory) and nothing (source, a name that is not there). ls-tree prints no commit id, so only <base> in argv is a placeholder and no stdout byte is rewritten. JSON escapes NUL as \u0000 and TAB as \t, so this file is ASCII.
